_comment: Reader settings for the image-correlation carpet G(xi, psi, Delta). 'Max frame lag' is what turns a RICS map into a STICS/TICS/iMSD carpet.

sections.title: Detector
sections.description: Detector settings of the image series.
Detector channel and geometry used to read the image stack.

sections.title: Acquisition
sections.description: Region of interest and preprocessing applied before the correlation is computed.
Region of interest (pixels) of each frame that enters the correlation.

sections.label: Subtract avg
sections.description: Subtract the mean intensity of each frame or of the whole stack before correlating, which removes immobile or slowly varying background.

sections.label: Max frame lag Δ
sections.description: Largest frame lag to correlate. 0 gives the zero-lag map only (RICS); higher values extend the same carpet along time, which is what STICS, TICS and iMSD read. Cost grows linearly with the number of lags.

sections.label: Drift correction
sections.description: Estimate and remove inter-frame sample drift before correlating. A translation between frames is indistinguishable from diffusive decorrelation, so uncorrected drift inflates the diffusion coefficient fitted from frame lags. 'First frame' compares every frame with frame 0 (best for slow monotonic drift); 'Previous frame' chains consecutive frames (tracks wander, accumulates error); 'Stack mean' compares against the average.

items.label: Center zero lag
items.description: Shift the zero-lag peak to the centre of the correlation surface.

sections.description: Display options of the correlation surface.

sections.label: Pixel dur [µs]
sections.description: Pixel dwell time. Sets the lag time of a one-pixel shift along the fast scan axis. Leave at 0 to take it from the TTTR header; a value set here overrides the header.

sections.label: Line dur [ms]
sections.description: Line time. Sets the lag time of a one-line shift along the slow scan axis. Leave at 0 to take it from the TTTR header; a value set here overrides the header.

sections.label: Frame dur [ms]
sections.description: Frame time; sets the lag time of a one-frame shift. Leave at 0 to estimate it as (lines per frame) x (line time).

sections.label: Pixel size [nm]
sections.description: Edge length of one pixel in the sample plane [nm]; converts pixel lags to distances.
